mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increase and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods with declining RSAFS, or the correlation between RSAFS decline and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increase and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in one month signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS decrease and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% each in one month signals a strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS increase > 1% each in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS does not correlate with positive returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in one month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between PAYEMS decrease and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods with increasing FEDFUNDS, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increase and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
